Before you hire

  1. Can you show vacation rental work comparable to this property?
  2. Do the fees include usage rights, twilight shots and revisions?
  3. What are the staging requirements and delivery timeline?

Ask for a written scope, itemized pricing, recent relevant references and confirmation that the vendor serves your exact address.
